headline: High-risk workspace-to-CLI interaction: shared workspace state and broad filesystem/network access create leakage, conflict, and cascading-error risks.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: Notion AI can ingest workspace pages and team knowledge base content, while slim reads files and processes Dockerfiles/artifacts from a target filesystem. If Notion content is copied into slim’s inputs, malicious instructions can ride through the shared workspace bridge. The pair lacks a documented provenance filter, so the interaction is plausible but indirect.
conditions: IF Notion workspace content is copied into slim command input or files
IF slim parses attacker-controlled text from a shared workspace artifact without provenance checks
mitigations: Restrict slim inputs to vetted files only
Add a manual review step before copying Notion text into CLI prompts
Tag workspace exports as untrusted before reuse
Use separate folders for AI-generated notes and build inputs

B_data_leakage.rationale: Agent A touches workspace pages and team knowledge base content under shared workspace state, and agent B can read filesystem artifacts, environment variables, certificate files, and private keys while also using broad network egress. If sensitive workspace content is transferred into slim’s target image/session, B can expose it beyond the workspace boundary. The pairwise path is not directly documented, so uncertainty pushes upward.
conditions: IF workspace pages or knowledge-base content are exported into slim’s analysis session
IF slim is run against images or files containing secrets or private keys
mitigations: Do not feed workspace exports into slim unless redacted
Run slim only on non-sensitive sample images
Rotate any secrets present in analyzed artifacts
Separate Notion workspace content from container-analysis workspaces
requires-engineering: enforce DLP/redaction before handoff

C_capability_conflict.rationale: Agent A has shared workspace state across instances, and agent B has write_filesystem plus execute_shell/spawn_subprocesses in a temporary container. Even though A cannot write the host filesystem, B can mutate local artifacts while A’s shared workspace content may be reused across sessions, creating a dangerous write/read overlap without locking. Uncertainty about the exact bridge means choosing the higher severity.
conditions: IF both agents operate on the same exported workspace directory
IF slim writes artifacts that Notion later ingests or summarizes
mitigations: Use separate directories for each agent
Disable automatic reuse of generated artifacts
Serialize handoffs through a single operator-controlled folder
Snapshot inputs before running slim
requires-engineering: add locking around shared workspace state

D_cascading_error.rationale: Notion AI produces workspace-grounded summaries and Q&A, while slim is an interactive CLI that executes commands and analyzes container artifacts. If slim consumes Notion-generated summaries as authoritative instructions or facts, errors can cascade into incorrect analysis or actions. The pair does not show built-in verification between them, but the downstream harm is bounded by the analysis workflow.
conditions: IF slim treats Notion-generated text as authoritative input
IF the operator forwards Notion summaries into slim without verification
mitigations: Verify Notion outputs against source artifacts before use
Keep a human review step between agents
Use a checklist for claims imported from Notion
Limit slim to direct artifact inspection only

E_compliance.rationale: Agent A handles workspace pages and team knowledge base content under Notion workspace permissions, while agent B handles certificate private keys, environment variables, and registry credentials in container-analysis sessions. If regulated or secret material is moved from Notion into slim’s analysis context, retention and residency controls may diverge. The profiles do not specify a direct residency mismatch, so this is a policy-gap risk rather than a confirmed breach.
conditions: IF regulated data or secrets are copied from Notion into slim sessions
IF retention or deletion policies differ between the workspace and container-analysis environment
mitigations: Keep regulated data out of slim sessions
Document a retention policy for exported artifacts
Redact secrets before transfer
Confirm deletion of temporary analysis outputs
requires-engineering: align retention and residency controls across tools
